rule_changes.justification: A launchd job configuring an interpreter, inline flag, environment, startup or stream setting is service configuration, not evidence of unwanted persistence. Preserve these observations as neutral traits; inline execution and environment settings remain notable. No package-specific name exclusion.
rule_changes.scope_change: The combined neutral interpreter-path matcher also recognizes conventional system/Homebrew paths for the same interpreters. The osascript-specific remote-pipe objective retains its exact /usr/bin/osascript constraint. Remote-pipe recurrence rules retain original severity and matchers. The -c/-e option must now be argument 1, preventing a script’s own later command-line option from being mistaken for an interpreter option. Names deliberately state -c/-e configuration because Perl -c checks syntax rather than executing inline source. AbandonProcessGroup must be true.
rule_changes.consumer_audit: Exact run-at-load, output, environment and working-directory consumers updated. Location aggregator retains relocated startup and ProcessType alternatives explicitly; no new broad configure-directory selector is used.
